description: How a plan derives a handoff from a lineage: the source of a divided shard, the destination of a fold that the ownership delta does not report, and the plan under the identity lineage.

cases.name: divided-source-from-the-parent
cases.note: `LIN-041`: the contents of the divided shard `0000000000002000` are held by the replicas of its parent `0000000000003000`, so the handoff names one of them as its source. A plan built over the ownership delta alone has no entry for the parent, whose replica set did not change, and names a source equal to the destination.

cases.name: folded-destination-outside-the-delta
cases.note: `LIN-044`: the shard that absorbs the folded extent keeps its replica set, so the ownership delta reports no entry for it, and a plan built over the delta alone moves nothing to the replica that does not hold the folded parent.

cases.name: slot-plan-over-the-identity-lineage
cases.note: `LIN-007`: under the identity lineage every shard is its own parent, so the plan is the one the ownership delta already produced and this case is the regression guard for it.
